summary: Subject apprehended by civic wardens inside Veridia Sector 4 for growing non-standard heirloom tomato variants in a decommissioned drainage pipe. The seeds used were not registered with the Ministry of Agricultural Purity. Subject claims he was merely attempting to supplement his family's synthetic protein rations.

Subject caught on low-resolution security surveillance altering a public propaganda billboard in Astraea. The digital display originally read 'The Consensus Breeds Stability.' Using a magnetic logic-splicer, the text was manipulated to read 'The Consensus Breeds Silence.' Subject claims she was fixing a terminal malfunction.
